critical.issue: Hangs > 60s and returns 502 via Cloudflare gateway when SMTP host is unreachable. Task spec explicitly says this endpoint must respond within ~10s (single-attempt, no retries). Single-attempt is implemented, BUT _send_smtp_email uses smtplib.SMTP_SSL(host, port, context=...) with NO `timeout=` argument, so a socket connect timeout takes ~2 min. Fix: add `timeout=8` (or similar) to the SMTP_SSL constructor in _send_smtp_email (server.py:215). This also affects /api/quote, /api/contact, /api/b2b, /api/buyback background _notify_lead: with retry delays [0,5,15] each attempt hangs ~2min → total ~6-7min for notifications to appear on a lead.

Task brief claims SMTP fails with '535 Incorrect authentication data'; actual error is TCP 'Connection timed out' — the SMTP host (nerus.o2switch.net:465) is not reachable from this env at all. Notification visibility still works correctly (email entry has status='failed', attempts=3, readable error, at timestamp).

Only pending backend fix is adding a socket timeout to smtplib.SMTP_SSL — once done, /admin/notifications/test will respond in <10s and /admin/notifications/test button in UI can be tested end-to-end. All other assertions in the task are already validated.
rca of the issue: Symptom: /api/admin/notifications/test returns HTTP 502 after 60s; new leads only get their `notifications` array populated after ~2 minutes instead of ~10s. Reproduction: `curl -X POST .../api/admin/notifications/test -d '{"store":"lattes"}'` hangs; direct smtplib test `smtplib.SMTP_SSL(SMTP_HOST, 465, timeout=15)` fails with 'TimeoutError: timed out'. Root cause: in backend/server.py:215, `smtplib.SMTP_SSL(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, context=context)` is called WITHOUT a `timeout=` parameter → default is None → OS-level TCP timeout (~2 min) applies. Since the SMTP host is unreachable in this env (network/firewall issue, not the 535 credential issue mentioned in the task brief), each SMTP attempt hangs the whole handler / background task for ~2 min. Cloudflare kills the HTTP connection at 60s → user sees 502. In _notify_lead, the retry loop with delays [0,5,15] compounds this into 6-7 min per lead. Mitigation: pass `timeout=8` (or similar reasonable value) to smtplib.SMTP_SSL; failure will be raised cleanly as socket.timeout and captured by the try/except → the endpoint returns email status='failed' with the timeout error immediately. This is a genuine feature-related bug introduced by the migration (endpoint author added single-attempt behavior for speed but did not add the socket timeout that speed requires).
